k: Crowd Favor can't be spent this event, so nothing can be bought at the Market. Cards and offerings can still provide weapons and armor.

The Arena Chest: 1 Arena Key opens it for a level-4 weapon. You can also pick it up and carry it (−1 movement while held). Digital rule: lifting it costs 1 movement, so you cannot take it with none left.
Pick up the chest: costs 1 movement (digital rule), then −1 movement on later turns while you carry it.
Digital rule: picking up the Arena Chest costs 1 movement, so with none left you cannot take it that turn. Carrying it still costs 1 movement on the turns after.
